newsitem.title: GREECE: TASOGLOU-DELONGHI TO POST LOWER 96 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: TASOGLOU-DELONGHI TO POST LOWER 96 PROFIT.

text.p: Greece's electrical appliance wholesaler Tasoglou Delonghi said its 1996 pretax profit fell 18.9 percent to 940 million drachmas from 1.16 billion a year earlier on sales growth of 2.7 percent to 7.4 billion.
The company said it will pay a fiscal 1996 dividend per share of 130 drachmas which translates to a dividend yield of 16.2 percent based on its Friday close at 798 drachmas.
The perky dividend also includes undistributed profits from the 1995 fiscal year.
The drop in profits was the outcome of lower demand for its products during November and December 1996 and the appreciation of the Italian lira against the drachma, up 8.08 percent, it said.
High temperatures during October, November and December last year and the farmers blockade of national roads saw sales of heating appliances fall below projections.
Tasoglou Delonghi completed a large part of its investment programme last year and its new building will reduce rental and storage expenses.
The company intends to expand its product range in 1997 and eyes activities in Turkey and Cyprus in cooperation with Italy's Delonghi SpA. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
